name: Band Bench Press
steps: Loop a resistance band across your upper back or under a flat bench and lie back with your feet planted firmly on the floor.
Grip both ends beside your chest with your shoulder blades retracted and elbows angled roughly 45 degrees from your torso.
Press both hands straight up over your chest until your arms are extended.
Lower your hands smoothly back to chest height while resisting the band's pull.
tips: Keep your wrists stacked directly over your elbows throughout each repetition.
Anchor your upper back on the bench so the band stays securely in place below your neck.
